name: Ishbi-Benob
bio: Ishbi-Benob was a Philistine descendant of the giants, armed with a bronze spearhead weighing three hundred shekels and a new sword; he set out to kill David, who had grown exhausted in the fighting. Abishai came to David's rescue and struck down the Philistine, saving the king's life. David's men then made him swear he would never again go out to battle with them, "so that the lamp of Israel would not be extinguished" (2 Samuel 21:15-17).
